summary: Imagine a community organized around shared space, repair and visible resource connections while keeping sustainability claims separate from appearance.
objective: Public spaces and service routes can be traced, and green decoration is not presented as proof of energy balance or environmental benefit.
intent_signals: Set the scene in a optimistic green-city fiction
Use solarpunk setting as the narrative setting
example_prompts: Create a solarpunk neighborhood with visible shared workshops and clearly labeled illustrative water routes.

principles: Imagine a community organized around shared space, repair and visible resource connections while keeping sustainability claims separate from appearance.
Theme supplies setting and motifs; choose geometry style, rendering approach and factual model independently.
implementation: Combine planted terraces, homes and workshops around accessible paths; make selected water or service routes inspectable as a declared diagram.
Use warm built surfaces, grouped vegetation and restrained technical accents under clear daylight-like illumination.
Start with a neighborhood overview and let the user inspect a resource route; animate events from a stated illustrative or computed model.
observable_checks: Public spaces and service routes can be traced, and green decoration is not presented as proof of energy balance or environmental benefit.
Inspect one focal object close up and the complete route or spatial relationship from an overview.

known_limits: Authored fictional setting guidance; no rendered artifact or runtime improvement has been observed for this record.
This proposal does not establish historical, cultural, scientific or engineering facts.
creative_affordances: Combine with stylized realism, hand-painted or technical-illustration layers; any claimed resource savings need supporting measurements or a model.
Replace motifs or combine settings to suit the user brief; maintain a readable organizing idea rather than treating these suggestions as a fixed asset list.
